text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey hey!
How do you think today's Arima Kinen will go!?
Can Tap beat Kris S!?”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No way, it's not just Tap today, Zenno Rob Roy is running too!
Man, there's no telling how this one's gonna go!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: —Hang in there, Symboli Kris S...! Show everyone the dominating race you always run, and prove you're the strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, you became a total Kris S fan.
Still, I'd really love to see Kris S reigning supreme...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...A complete transformation, one might say.
This too is the fruit of your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Today, as just another spectator, I think I'll watch over this race with a pounding heart.
—Do your best, Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Well then, I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Giving me... such unwavering trust...
all this time..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...To that unchanging trust...
I will—without fail—live up to it."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: By becoming the unyielding... "ordeal" myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
And...—it's slightly different.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That... is who we are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: “—Can you feel it? This heat.”

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: This is even bigger than the Japan Cup. Seems everyone's dying to see our "romance" clash head-on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――……Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What? What's with you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Because an Umamusume like Tap... was there for me—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I can... fulfill—
my "mission"—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So—I want to give my thanks.
And—that's precisely why……—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I will win.
—As the 'ordeal.'"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You say you got better at picking fights
after coming to Japan?
Bring it on, Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll take on the challenge again and again.
I'll fire myself up as many times as it takes!
Let's run the greatest races together, over and over!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Hasta la vista, baby!"
The one who's gonna take you down today—is me!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—Now that's more like it... That's who you are.
...Tap Dance City.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (...Magnificent. To come this far in the Classic stage—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...The way you ran.
The figure you presented to the world.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Turning all of that into my strength now—
I challenge you today.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I didn't come here just to compete...!
I came here... to seize victory!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
As one who aspires to be a "Hero"—
I must overcome the "trials" that befall all brave souls!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Then—I shall accept the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: As your... 'trial.'
